meta_description: 4,643 likes, 28 comments - alexstrohl on October 16, 2026: "“Die sömmerung” or summer Alpine herding is something I’ve romanticized since my first July hikes as a kid. I imagined a life amongst flower strewn meadows and baths in cold creeks. The reality is very different. The image of multigenerational families spending the summer together tending to the animals is largely a relic. Today a good part of the Alpine workers in Switzerland are hired hands from Germany, Austria, or Poland. They’ve got Starlink and the cows get airlifted if they’re injured. I ran into this Alpine herder a few years ago and I can’t remember his name for sure but he had come from Eastern Europe to work the summer. He disliked going into town and said he appreciated the silence up here. He invited me in for a drink. We swapped a few stories and I left. Part of me wishes I didn’t learn about the realities of this idealized job.. I guess that’s part of growing up.".
